photos.desc: First flowers a bit feeble but I have high hopes for the future
Aconitum anthora in the Jardin Botanique Alpin du Lautaret
First flowering of this lovely species. Mature plants should be more upright but still quite small
Yellow Monkshood ( Aconitum anthora ), Chéserex, La Dôle
